newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia man opens fire in store, kills himself.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia man opens fire in store, kills himself.

text.p: An elderly man gunned down another man and wounded two women Thursday in a supermarket here before committing suicide, police reported.
Witnesses said a man identified as Drew Cade of Philadelphia shot a woman employee at the courtesy counter and a woman shopper before killing the man, said police spokesman Al Strong.
Witnesses told KYW Radio news that Cade said, "You're not going to treat me like this. I'm not going to take this any more."
